items.description: Welcome to Bloodwatch, a short horror survival game developed by Gamingscape. When going out in a solo adventure, your ship has been sunken by an unexpected storm. You have been washed ashore by a wave. Waking up, you have realized you have been stuck in an unknown island. You search around to see is there any animal or people living in here. After a while, you see a group of people are torturing and beat one of the person to death. They have caught you watching them. You run away as fast as you can, hiding behind a lighthouse. You can hear the cult leader ordering every of his soldiers to find and kill you. You open your backpack, equipping the nightvision. Now you must plan a tactics, find the weapons on the island, kill the cult leader and all of his soldiers to escape this place. Find 5 types of weapons scatter around the island : Knife, Axe, Baseball Bat, Handgun, Crossbow. Each types of weapons have different amount of damage. You can be tired when running and attacking with melee weapons, so be careful. Enemies are very strong, don't fight them if there is 2 or more. Collecting apples to restore your health, each will restore near 1/3 of your health bar. Finding batteries to replenish your nightvision. Ammo and arrows are scarce, use it wisely. Finding 3 types of keys to open locking doors. Controls: I for Inventory, click on the weapon icon when you find them to equip or changing them. E to pickup items. Reloading gun and crossbow: I to Inventory, click the gun and the bullet magazine icon to reload with gun, click the crossbow then the arrow icon to reload with crossbow Replenish batteries: I to Inventory, click on the battery icon in the Batteries. Heal health: Go to Inventory then click at the apple icon. O for Ingame options, save and exit game. N for Nightvision, can clear a good amount of heavy fog. F For Flashlight. Left and Right Mouse for attacking with melee weapons, shooting gun, crossbow. W+ Shift to run, W, A , S, D to move. The saving system: After save, if you die or exit the game, you will be back from the beginning, but still keep all your weapons and items. If you die without saving, the game ends. Press ESC to exit the game immediately. Use the tiny dot in the middle of the screen for easy pickups. items.description: Legendary Realms: A Fantasy World Odyssey is a vast and intricate multiplayer game that takes players on an unforgettable journey through a captivating world filled with magic, mystery, and adventure. At the start of the game, players create their own unique character, selecting from a range of classes including warrior, ranger, and mage. Each class offers a different play style and set of abilities, allowing players to tailor their character to their own preferences and play style. Once players have created their character, they are free to explore the world of Legendary Realms, taking on quests and challenges as they go. Quests can range from simple tasks like delivering items or defeating low-level enemies, to more complex missions that require strategic thinking and teamwork. As players progress through the game, they earn rewards and level up, improving their character's stats and unlocking new abilities. They can also purchase equipment from shops and vendors, including weapons, armor, and magical artifacts, which can be used to enhance their combat abilities and increase their chances of success. One of the key features of Legendary Realms is its multiplayer component. Players can team up with others to take on quests and challenges together, combining their skills and abilities for greater success. Additionally, the game offers a robust social system that allows players to communicate with one another, make friends, and form guilds. Beyond its engaging gameplay and multiplayer features, Legendary Realms boasts a rich and immersive world that is sure to captivate players. From towering mountains and dense forests to bustling cities and mysterious ruins, the game's world is filled with detail and nuance, making it feel alive and vibrant. Overall, Legendary Realms: A Fantasy World Odyssey is an incredible adventure that offers endless possibilities for exploration, questing, and combat. Whether you're a fan of fantasy games, multiplayer games, or both, this game is sure to provide hours of entertainment and excitement.
